# Version 4.158.0
> **Renderer and shaping updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes. HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named script constants without changing its Script programming model. Renderer fixes address reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip limits and affected Vulkan device-loss cleanup.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Updates the bundled rendering engine to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface or adding C bridge exports. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))
- **HarfBuzz 15.0.0** — Upgrades the bundled shaping engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0 while retaining HarfBuzzSharp assembly version 1.0.0.0. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **More named HarfBuzz scripts** — Adds 30 Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while preserving all 149 existing constants. Script remains a struct with the same parsing, numeric-conversion and horizontal-direction APIs. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Reflected hairlines and text atlases** — Corrects square-cap sizing for zero-length hairlines under reflected scaling and guards non-finite results. Ganesh rounds ordinary and LCD text-atlas indices to prevent interpolation imprecision from selecting the wrong sampler. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Bounded Graphite clip recording** — Accounts for undrawn clip elements when flushing a render pass. A draw whose clips cannot fit a fresh pass is rejected and logged rather than overflowing the pass structures. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup** — Ganesh and Graphite add a 1 ms delay on affected device-loss paths for ARM proprietary drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. Ordinary successful submissions are not delayed by this workaround. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Upgrades the bundled engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0. Adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while preserving the existing struct-based API and constants.

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 upgrades HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. It also corrects reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss workaround.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while its native engine remains at 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
